question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Not Only The Things That Have Happened'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mridula Koshy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mridula Koshy is the author of the book **'Not Only The Things That Have Happened'**.
 
• The book was published in **2012**.
 
• Mridula Koshy is an Indian writer and library activist based in **New Delhi**.
 
• She has also authored other works such as **'If It Is Sweet'**, a collection of short stories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mridula Koshy**

 
 
• Mridula Koshy was born in 1968 and spent her early years in India before moving to the United States.
 
• She returned to India in 2005 and has been actively involved in promoting library access through her community library project.
 
• Her literary work often explores themes of displacement, identity, and the struggles of marginalized communities.
 
 
 
• **'Not Only The Things That Have Happened'**
 
 
• The novel spans multiple generations and explores the complexities of human relationships and memory.
 
• It is written in a non-linear narrative style, reflecting the fragmented nature of memory.
 
• The story revolves around the search for a lost child and the impact of this loss on different characters over time.
 
 
 
• **Indian Literature**
 
 
• Indian literature has a rich history that dates back thousands of years, encompassing diverse languages and traditions.
 
• Contemporary Indian writers often address social issues, including gender, caste, and economic disparities.
 
• Indian authors have gained international recognition, with works being translated into numerous languages worldwide.
